findings.title: Component ownership is stricter than actual lot sampling
findings.evidence: tools/parcel-capacity-profile.mjs:28,32 groups by stored cell edgeId/side/class and filters stored depth. grid.js:319-327 instead checks sampled cell existence, matching class and prior claims; it does not enforce stored edgeId, side or depth. A lot road owner does not imply identical owner metadata on every sampled raster cell.
findings.implication: 804/789 are conditional component-model quotients, not established upper bounds on current legal lot generation. Reassignment is not solely a hypothetical future algorithm.

findings.title: Existing-lot validation does not validate the bound assumptions
findings.evidence: Tool line36 first filters lot.cells to the preferred set, then checks only eight-neighbour connectivity, without owner/class component identity. It also does not check unique cell count against LOT_SLOTS*LOT_DEPTH or disjoint allocation across lots. grid.js:400-403 appends quantized keys without deduplication.
findings.implication: The recorded zero disconnected lots proves connected nonempty retained subsets only. It does not prove all original lot cells fit one component or satisfy the distinct-cell area assumption. Actual duplicate/overlap counts were not captured; this review does not claim they occurred.

findings.title: No candidate justified is supported; architectural necessity is not proved
findings.evidence: The actual _splitRun fixes k=floor(runLength/want) before remainder/corner assignment. The current run alone cannot gain another complete lot from moving its remainder. However altered sampling, earlier-edge competition or later-edge claims are not explored by this diagnostic. Historical r7s trials are two specific rejected layouts, not an exhaustive search.
findings.implication: Accept the decision to select no product change. Qualify coordinated frontage work as a reasonable next investigation, not a proven requirement or proof that every bounded splitter change is impossible.

findings.title: Saved evidence supports arithmetic checks but not replay of all connectivity counts
findings.evidence: Only 30 largest four-neighbour components per category per seed are saved. No full cells/lots map or eight-neighbour component list is present. pass checks only errors and the cell partition equality.
findings.implication: Class aggregate quotients and all 120 retained component quotients can be recomputed; global connectivity counts and 150/137/804/789 cannot independently be rebuilt from this artifact. Repeated-run equality is a builder assertion without a second retained final record.

nextOwnerSafePriority.task: Validate the model against actual sampled slot runs before choosing a product change. Retain full cell/lot evidence, quantify mixed stored-owner membership, excluded-depth cells, unique-cell area and overlaps, then compare actual feasible run yield for both seeds. If proposing corridors, predict yield using the real owner algorithm and preserve identity/restage and rendering budgets.
nextOwnerSafePriority.restriction: No smaller lot contract, decorative stock, count padding or unverified redesign justified by this diagnostic.

limits: Read-only audit of supplied JSON and source; no browser rerun, screenshot inspection, build, API/restage or performance test. None is required to review a no-product-change structural diagnosis.
No visual score recalibration or gate passes. Raw/retained memory and FPS are unmeasured in R8t.
Profile contains aggregate counts and truncated component lists; full graph, slot runs and original lot cell membership are absent.

Area quotients are genuine upper bounds only under assumed disjoint distinct-cell minimum allocation and full inclusion in the modeled domains; those assumptions are not validated against actual lot generation.

Class-only pooling removes edge constraints but retains stored-depth filtering and the unverified distinct-cell area premise. 1229/1244 neither certifies buildable lots nor proves the actual 1400-lot target impossible.

Most unclaimed cells are in stored preferred depth (86.11%/86.33%). Calling all of them longitudinal remainder is an inference: availability, sampling, ownership competition and junctions were not separately attributed.
Historical 573/695/612 counts were checked in r7s cityscale records. Their successful probe flags are not city-scale specification passes. Their source restoration is not newly audited here.
